data: Your next Heavy Melee attack against an enemy deals increased damage.
Your imbued ability charges up over time with bonus spirit damage, bonus fire rate, and reloads bullets on use.
While you are below 50% health, you gain stat bonuses for a duration and existing debuffs on you are reduced.
Each hero kill grants permanent Fire Rate (up to a max of 8 times). Death results in the loss of 1 stack.
While reloading, pressing Reload during the highlighted portion will instantly finish your reload and grant you Fire Rate, Bullet Lifesteal and Move Speed.
Your next bullet deals bonus spirit damage.
Periodically deals spirit damage to the closest two enemies nearby.
When you perform a Light or Heavy Melee attack against a hero, deal extra spirit damage with the attack and reduce the target's Spirit Resist.
Cooldown is 2x longer for Light Melee hits.
Launch yourself high into the air and grant yourself a Barrier. While in the air, you can use the active again to drop down faster.
Cannot be used for 5s if attacked by enemy Hero.
Reset the cooldown of the imbued non-ultimate ability.
This item's cooldown is increased by the cooldown of the imbued ability.
Bonus Spirit Power for Charged Abilities
Your bullets build up to a Silence. Victims are immune to the build up for 10s after silence expires.
Any time you secure or deny a Soul from an entity you get ammo back and gain stacking Spirit Power.
At Max Stacks, gain bonus Sprint speed
Your Melee Attack applies Movement Slow and heals you for a percentage of the Melee Damage dealt plus a fixed amount.
This heal is 40% effective vs non-heroes.
Cooldown is 1.5x as long for Light Melee hits.
Imbue an ability with permanent Spirit Power. When that ability is used, gain bonus Move Speed and maintain full speed while attacking.
Teleport to an enemy target and pull them to the ground. Dealing damage, Move speed reduction and Disarm.
Your bullets have a chance to be empowered, causing them to deal bonus weapon damage on hit.
Your Weapon Damage increases as you take sustained damage.
Your next Melee attack heals you.
This heal is 30% effective vs non-heroes.
Remove all non-stun debuffs from the target and provide them with a Barrier and Move Speed.
Can be self-cast. Cooldown is reduced by half when cast on someone else.
Grant Regen and Sprint Speed to the target. Gets dispelled if you take damage from enemy players or objectives. Can be self-cast.
Heals a target allied hero and yourself for a percentage of Max Health. Once while healing, you can Pull the target towards you. Can be self-cast.
Slows movement of enemy target. Also Silences their movement-based items and abilities.
Does not affect target's stamina usage.
Throw a flask that explodes on contact, creating an area that does increasing spirit damage per second and reduces enemy Bullet Resist.
Your next headshot against an enemy Hero deals bonus weapon damage.
Your bullets build up to reduce the target's outgoing damage and apply healing reduction.
Provides Bullet Resist to nearby friendly units.
Provides move speed and fire rate to you and nearby allies. Minions get double value.
Deal additional Weapon Damage when beyond a minimum distance from your target.
Grow larger in size, gaining bullet resist, spirit resist, and melee damage.
Nearby enemies suffer from slow and have reduced dash speed.
Reduces nearby enemies' Bullet Resist and Fire Rate. If there is only one enemy hero nearby, this effect is doubled.
Briefly gain Fire Rate and Move Speed when one of your bullets hits an enemy hero.
Temporarily suppress negative status effects and become immune to Stun, Silence, Sleep, Root, and Disarm.
Cannot be used while Stunned or Slept.
Gain bonus Move Speed and Slow Resistance.
Removes the Move Speed penalty while shooting.
After not taking damage for a period, gain health regen.
When you are above 75% health, you have bonus Move Speed.
Your next bullet will heal you based on what target you hit.
Landing a Headshot will reduce their Bullet and Spirit Resist and applies Healing Reduction.
If you die, after 4s you will respawn at your death location with partial health.
Dash forward, gaining slow resistance while leaving a flaming trail that deals spirit damage over time.
Hold [W] while active to dash farther.
Enable 2 Ability Charges with 14s Recharge time
Channel an expanding storm cloud around you that damages all enemies within its radius. Enemies do not take damage when they are out of line-of-sight.
+55% Bullet Resist while channeling Storm Cloud
Throw a stake that tethers enemies to the location where the stake lands. Enemy movement is restricted to the length of the tether.
Leap into the air and fly. While in flight your weapon deals bonus spirit damage and your items have increased range.
+10.0 Spirit Damage with increased Spirit scaling
Your crow familiar deals impact damage, reduces their bullet resist and applies a bleed that deals damage based on the target's current health.

Use your scoped rifle to fire a powerful shot over long distances. Deal only partial damage until fully charged after 1.0s of being scoped. Does bonus damage to enemies with less than 50% health remaining. Landing a killing blow on a player with Assassinate grants you bonus weapon damage.
Sacrifice some of your health to launch a bomb that deals damage after a brief arm time.
Self damage type is Spirit and can be mitigated.
Bombs leave a toxic mess on the ground, dealing 30.0% of the original damage per second, for 6s.
Sacrifice some of your health to launch blood shards that apply a stack of Malice. Each stack slows the victim and increases the damage they take from you. The slow effect decreases over time.
Charge forward, pulling enemies you hit. Pushing a hero into a wall applies stun.
If you collide with a hero you move faster during your charge.
On Hero Collide: +1.5 Weapon Damage for 6s
Gain bonus defensive attributes. Taking damage grants temporary regeneration for a portion of the damage taken.
Leap high into the air before crashing into the ground, dealing spirit damage and applying stun.
On cast, become Unstoppable for 5s and +6m Impact Radius

Deal weapon damage to summon cards of a random suit. Each card can be thrown, dealing damage and applying a different effect depending of its suit. Cards thrown fly towards the enemy or point under your crosshair.
All suits are improved and higher chance for Jokers
Cast a wall that applies slow on enemies it passes through. Erupt the wall to divide the terrain in half and damage nearby enemies.
After casting, press or Ability 3 to erupt the wall early.
Can be Destroyed with Melee Attacks
Amplifies McGinnis's damage by +20% on hit enemies for 7s
Deploy 2 Mini Turrets near the wall for 8s
Unleashes a volley of rockets that home in on a targeted location.
McGinnis is slowed and is still able to use stamina.
Applies 24% movement and dash slow for 1s
+2m Radius and +15.0 Damage per Rocket with increased spirit scaling
Fire a projectile that swaps your position with the target enemy hero.
200 Barrier for 8s. Barrier scales with Spirit
Swaps all enemies within 7m of hit target and +10% Max Health Damage
Release an energy pulse that travels along the ground, dealing spirit damage and applying knockup.
On Hit: -15% Bullet Resist and -24% Move Speed for 4s
Briefly become untargetable while teleporting to the target location. Restores stamina upon use.
While channeling, restore health over time to you and any allies nearby.
You can dash and melee without breaking the channel.
Aura provides +4m Move Speed during channel
Full move and ability use and additionally heals +2.5% of Max Health per second
Kelvin creates a floating trail of ice and snow that gives movement bonuses to him and his allies. Kelvin gains 60% slow resistance for the duration. Enemies can also walk on the floating trail.
Press Dash / Crouch / slide to travel up or down while in Ice Path.
+2m Move Speed and +35% Bullet Resist for Kelvin while on Ice Path
+35% Spirit and +20 Spirit for Kelvin while on Ice Path

Shoot freezing cold energy out in front of you, damaging targets and progressively reducing their movement and fire rate the longer you sustain the beam on them. You have reduced move speed while using Arctic Beam. The beam may also claim Souls.
-20.0% to Fire Rate and Move Speed
-13s Cooldown and Fires 2 additional Arctic Beams within 10m of the last target hit.
Target yourself or a Hero to freeze the air and create an impenetrable dome around them. While in the dome, allies gain rapid regeneration and enemies are slowed.
Objectives becomes Invulnerable and Frozen under Frozen Shelter
Purges non-ult debuffs for you and your allies.
+65 Health Regen and increased Spirit Scaling

Throw a dagger that damages and sleeps the target. Sleeping targets wake up shortly after being damaged. Throwing a Dagger does not break your invisibility. Sleep Dagger does not interrupt enemies' channeling abilities.
-10.0% Bullet Resist Reduction for 6.0s on wake-up
-40% Move and Dash Speed for 3s on wake-up
Launch out a mechanical hand that pulls the first character it hits, reeling them in.
Grapple Arm can be used on allies.
Channel a powerful torrent of energy that deals spirit damage and applies slow.
Hyper Beam heals Bebop for 65% of its damage on Heroes. 20% on non-hero
Charge up a powerful shot that pierces through enemies. Hold Ability 1 or to hold the shot.
Improved damage scaling and -3s Charge Delay
Launches you high in the air, allowing you to glide slowly. While airborne, you gain Weapon Damage and multishot on your weapon.
Press Jump / mantle to cancel the glide.
While airborne, +3 Weapon Damage and weapon damage applies 24% movement slow for 1.5s
While airborne, +30% Bullet Lifesteal, +30% Spirit Lifesteal and +30% Bullet Evasion
After 1.5s cast time, launch a spirit owl that you control and which explodes on impact, damaging and stunning enemies. Hold [W] to accelerate the owl.
Press Jump / mantle to release control. Gain permanent Spirit Power for each enemy hero killed with Guided Owl.
After hit, kills enemies that are below 22% Health
Deal damage to nearby enemies and heal yourself based on the damage done. Heal is stronger against enemy heroes.
Adds a debuff to enemies that lets Mo & Krill deal +15% Damage to them. Stacks and lasts 16s.
Hold the target in place, stunning them and dealing damage during the channel. If they die during, or within 3 seconds of Combo ending, you permanently gain max health.
+0.7s Duration and +40.0 Damage Per Second and increased scaling
Throw a knife that bleeds an enemy. Each additional hit adds a stack and refreshes the bleed duration, causing the bleed to increase per stack.
+12.0 Bleed DPS with increased Spirit scaling
Perform a dash forward, damaging enemies along the path. Hit Enemies have their spirit resist reduced. This debuff can stack.
Active: Leap forward, dealing spirit damage to the first enemy hero. If they are below the kill threshold, execute them instead.
Finishing an enemy with Killing Blow lets you recast for 16s
Passive: Damaging enemies fills you with rage. While at full rage, Shiv gains increased damage and unlocks special properties on his other abilities.
Grab an ally and take flight with them. Drop your ally to cause an explosion, dealing spirit damage. You and your ally gain increased Outgoing Damage when flying ends.
Cooldown reduced by 30% when used on allies.
Taking damage briefly disables using the ability.
While lifted, your ally cannot attack and deals -20% damage.
On Fly End : 300 Barrier to Ivy and ally that scales with Spirit
Throw a flask that damages and reduces the weapon damage and move speed of enemies it hits.
After charging for 2s, release pulses that damage enemies and heal you based on the damage done.
While channeling Last Stand you have greatly increased bullet and spirit resist.
Channel to increase damage over 1.4 seconds, then release a fully-charged sword strike.
Press Ability 1 or to trigger the strike early, dealing partial damage.
+150.0 Damage and Increases Spirit Power scaling
Throw a grappling hook to reel yourself towards an enemy, dealing Light melee damage and slowing the target when you arrive.

Become infused with Yamato's shadow soul. After an initial invincible transformation your abilities are refreshed and are 60% faster. You gain immunity to negative status effects and have greatly increased bullet and spirit resist.
When you get a hero kill, you heal and the duration is extended.
Throw a ball of goo that deals damage and leaves puddles of goo behind that apply movement slow to enemies in the radius.
Bounces 1 times and improves Spirit Scaling
Materialize a fist in the world that punches everyone in the area, applying knockup.
Punching an enemy deals melee damage and applies slow.
You and your allies have increased Air Control.
-14.0s Cooldown and now deals Heavy Melee Damage
Morph into a large goo ball that deals damage and stuns enemies on impact. The ball grants large amounts of Bullet and Spirit resist, bounces off walls and can double jump.
+7s Duration, +0.3s Stun Duration, and +0.2 Spirit Scaling
Channel to start launching projectiles that deal spirit damage and apply slow around their impact point. Projectiles that hit a hero grant Pocket increased damage that stacks.
Casting while airborne will cause Pocket to float.
Casting AirDash or Flying Cloaking will not cancel Barrage.
Launch a sentient cloak that travels forward and damages enemies. You can press Ability 2 to teleport to its location.
